start.name_zh: 铜梁区/合川区交界处（旧县街道附近，川气东送二线川渝鄂段二阶段·铜梁-潜江段干线起点，里程0km）
start.name_en: Tongliang District / Hechuan District boundary (near Jiuxian Subdistrict), start of the Tongliang-Qianjiang trunk (Phase 2 of the Sichuan-Chongqing-Hubei section)
start.geocode_source: No GPS given for the boundary point itself. EIA Table 2.2-22 ('铜梁-潜江段干线沿线地区等级划分情况', row 1) states the trunk-segment start is '铜梁/合川县界' at km 0/0. Proxy coordinate is a groundwater monitoring-well point ('四龙村16组', unlabeled well ID) at 106.187E/29.886N in 铜梁区旧县街道 (Jiuxian Subdistrict, Tongliang District), the nearest sourced place in the same EIA document, ~10m from the pipeline centerline per the doc's own note.

end.name_zh: 潜江分输压气站（潜江市总口管理区，OCR原文误作'洪江市'）
end.name_en: Qianjiang Distribution Compressor Station, Zongkou Management District, Qianjiang City, Hubei
end.geocode_source: EIA Table 2.2-22 (row 52) states the trunk's terminus is '潜江分输压气站 | 洪江市总口管理区' at km 863.06 (洪江市 is an OCR misread of 潜江市 -- 洪江市 is in Hunan and does not border Hubei/this corridor; 潜江市总口管理区 matches GEM's EndLocation and the doc's own compressor-station description elsewhere, '潜江压气站位于湖北省潜江市杨市街道总口农场管理区'). Coordinate used is the document's own GPS for a directional-drilling crossing at 百里长渠 within 总口管理区 (112°52'2.92"E 30°19'29.98"N). Corroborated within ~7km by Nominatim query '杨市街道,潜江市,湖北省' -> OSM node 5575423782 (30.3714N/112.9000E), the parent subdistrict named in the doc's compressor-station sentence.

corridor_notes: 855km (sheet) / 863.06km (EIA cumulative mileage) Tongliang-Qianjiang trunk, the Phase 2 (二阶段) trunk of the 川气东送二线天然气管道工程川渝鄂段 (Sichuan-Shanghai Parallel Gas Pipeline, Sichuan-Chongqing-Hubei section). Runs from the Tongliang/Hechuan district boundary (Chongqing) through numbered valve chambers 9# (北碚区澄江镇) - 10# (合川区草街镇) - 11# (北碚区柳荫镇) - 12# (渝北区大湾镇) - 大盛站(渝北区统景镇) - 14# (长寿区葛兰镇) - 16# (垫江县砚台镇) - ...on through further Chongqing/Hubei counties (忠县, 云阳, etc. per the same table, not individually resourced here) - to the Qianjiang Distribution Compressor Station in Hubei. GEM's Status='construction' is consistent with this being the currently-building Phase 2 trunk (vs. the completed Phase 1 Weiyuan/Luxian-Tongliang segment and the still-public-comment-stage Phase 3 supply branches). This trunk is what my 7 sibling PIDs (P7581-P7587, Phase 3 local supply branches) tap off of.
researcher_notes: Both master EIA PDFs (环境影响报告书, not just the brief 批复 approval notices) for the 川渝鄂段 project are hosted on archive.org with full OCR text: Phase 1 (Weiyuan/Luxian-Tongliang trunk) at 034f-60b-7539c-46b-78f-68bcdf-4feb-9975, Phase 2 (this PID's trunk, Tongliang-Qianjiang, + the 4 major storage-facility branches) at 759f-1a-193815494692b-2742c-895d-53a-7. Both already existed as GEM's 'current_route_ref' in worklist.json but were unused before this research pass -- confirmed high-value primary sources, reused across all 8 of my PIDs. Table 2.2-22 in the Phase 2 doc is the authoritative valve-chamber/township location table for this trunk and is the anchor for locating 5 of my 7 branch PIDs' start points (12#, 9#, 16# directly; DAT4# and 6# via a separate sub-branch table / the Phase 1 doc respectively). ResearcherNotes on this row (and the 7 branch rows) says 'MZ: ...（二阶段）' -- based on the EIA's own phase breakdown (line ~2898-2905 of the OCR text, '二阶段建设铜梁-潜江段干线、和牢家坪老翁场储气库支干线、大英-安岳-铜梁支干线、铜锣峡储气库支干线、黄草峡储气库支干线；三阶段建设...供气支线'), THIS trunk (P7568) genuinely is Phase 2 scope, matching the MZ note -- but the 7 short branch PIDs (P7581-P7587) are Phase 3 (三阶段) '供气支线' scope, so the shared '二阶段' ResearcherNotes label on those 7 rows appears to be an imprecise carryover, not accurate to this EIA's own phase definitions. Documented here rather than corrected on the sheet.
